records.statement: Project Intent runtime, persistence, access and recovery must not require SparkOps, SparkOps Cloud, Projects, Verify or the main SayHi application to run.
records.title: PI-INDEPENDENCE-01

records.statement: Authenticate every data request and authorize scopes before aggregation, detail, counts, attention, architecture applicability, or cross-scope relationships. Boundary-key equality never grants cross-scope access.
records.title: PI-SCOPES-01

records.statement: PM provider owns durable intent. Cached snapshots are last-known non-authoritative projections; presence and execution observations have distinct freshness. Missing observations never mean available or safe.
records.title: PI-TRUTH-01

records.statement: Observatory is read-only. Matching declared evidence/invariant revisions is not verified conformance; implementation completion is not production authorization.
records.title: PI-OBSERVE-01

acceptance: Real provider workstreams visible with scoped counts/detail and explicit cache freshness.
Show readiness, handoffs, evidence, applicable invariant revision comparisons, semantic convergence and environment requirements without availability invention.
Distinct execution-source-unavailable and provider-cache fallback semantics; service operates with no SparkOps/application endpoint.
Scope isolation and fail-closed access tested through API; browser UI uses normalized API only.
Independent review and bounded corrections before handoff; production activation separate.
Workers use supported reporting and enrollment; operator actions are scope-checked and auditable; uncertain delivery is explicit.
Provisional session continuation is bound to confirmed session/checkout and request identity; browser stays read-only.
records.avoid: No product-runtime dependency, public deployment, destructive outage on real systems, provider fork, synthetic project lifecycle, new PM datastore, scheduler, provisioning or UI mutation commands. Preserve working SparkOps prototype.

environment.forbidden: No Compose/VM allocation or product credentials
environment.profile_reference: sparkops/local-dev-v1 is a consumer reference, not a platform runtime dependency
environment.requirement: checkout-local Python 3.12 stdlib service and .venv; loopback only

records.handoff_summary: Independent read-only Mission Control approved for bounded local dogfood. Successor: source-seal this uncommitted checkout, establish remote/normal CI with explicit authority, and qualify provider least privilege, managed service and backup recovery before broader deployment. No product outage or production activation performed. Environment owner review/catalog digest reconciliation remains separate.
records.handoff_verification: 20 tests independently rerun by observatory_review; approved-local. Browser and isolated cache-outage checks executed by implementation worker, not independently repeated.
records.scope: Independent sayhi-project-intent repository, normalized read model, provisional provider adapter, authenticated loopback service, static observatory, cache/export/offline orientation, tests and deployment/recovery contract. User-authorized continuation: supported local reporting/outbox, scoped operator provider reconciliation, provisional existing-session connector, worker/orchestrator skill, real dogfood and independent source sealing. Mature SparkOps admitted execution bridge is deferred.
records.statement: Deliver a small independent, scoped, read-only Mission Control over real provider-backed Project Intent state.
records.title: PI-MISSION-01
